**[[Humanitarian impact of the Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Humanitarian impact of the Sudanese civil war]]
***[[Khartoum]] reports 384 cases of [[dengue fever]] which are attributed to the ongoing [[humanitarian crisis]] in [[Sudan]]. [https://www.altaghyeer.info/en/2024/04/08/nearly-400-dengue-cases-reported-in-sudans-bahri-city/ (Al Taghyeer)]

'''Law and crime'''
*Protesters [[arson|set fire]] to government buildings and dozens of vehicles in the [[Mexican state]] of [[Guerrero]] amid anger over the police killing of a college student in March and the [[Iguala mass kidnapping|kidnapping]] of 43 students in 2014. [[List of governors of Guerrero|Governor]] [[Evelyn Salgado Pineda]]'s office in [[Chilpancingo]] is ransacked. [https://apnews.com/article/mexico-missing-students-guerrero-protesters-burn-government-office-8561a6ae7f1e8fff28d5fbccdfc416be (AP)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Solar eclipse of April 8, 2024]]
**A [[total solar eclipse]] occurs in [[North America]] for the first time since [[Solar eclipse of August 21, 2017|2017]]. It is the last total solar eclipse to be visible in the [[contiguous United States]] until [[Solar eclipse of August 23, 2044|2044]]. [https://www.foxweather.com/weather-news/total-solar-eclipse-april-8-2024-us-canada-mexico (Fox Weather)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2024 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament]]
**In [[college basketball]], [[2023–24 UConn Huskies men's basketball team|Connecticut]] repeats as national champions, becoming the first program to do so since the [[Florida Gators men's basketball|Florida Gators]] did so in [[2006 NCAA Division I men's basketball championship game|2006]] and [[2007 NCAA Division I men's basketball championship game|2007]].
